name: usage-band
description: Usage band above the prompt: limits with projection, context, tokens, speed, cost, turns, tools, churn, agents, model, effort, folder, git and memory, each one switchable

show5h.title: Usage band: 5-hour limit
show5h.description: Usage of the 5-hour rate-limit window and time to reset

show7d.title: Usage band: 7-day limit
show7d.description: Usage of the 7-day rate-limit window and time to reset

showSpendLimit.title: Usage band: spend limit
showSpendLimit.description: A gateway's spend limit, when the account reports one

showContext.title: Usage band: context window
showContext.description: How full the context window is

showThinking.title: Usage band: thinking tokens
showThinking.description: The part of output spent on extended thinking

showCacheRead.title: Usage band: cache read tokens
showCacheRead.description: Input tokens served from the prompt cache

showCacheHit.title: Usage band: cache hit rate
showCacheHit.description: Share of all input read from the prompt cache

showWeb.title: Usage band: web searches and fetches
showWeb.description: Server-side web search and fetch requests

showSpeed.title: Usage band: output speed
showSpeed.description: Tokens per second of the last response (hover for the average)

showCost.title: Usage band: session cost
showCost.description: Session cost at API list prices

showCostRate.title: Usage band: cost per hour
showCostRate.description: Average spend per hour since the session started

showLastTurn.title: Usage band: last turn
showLastTurn.description: Duration, cost and output speed of the last turn

showTools.title: Usage band: tool calls
showTools.description: Tool calls, failures and the most used tools

showChurn.title: Usage band: lines changed
showChurn.description: Lines added and removed by Edit, MultiEdit and Write

showCompactions.title: Usage band: compactions
showCompactions.description: How often the context was compacted and what it freed

showModel.title: Usage band: model
showModel.description: The model that answered last, and the Claude Code version

showEffort.title: Usage band: thinking effort
showEffort.description: The thinking effort of the last request (low to max)

showFolder.title: Usage band: folder
showFolder.description: The working directory's name (hover for the full path)

showGit.title: Usage band: git branch
showGit.description: Branch, uncommitted files, ahead and behind

limitProjection.title: Usage band: limit projection
limitProjection.description: Project 5h/7d usage at reset from the pace so far and warn when it would pass 100%

contextBreakdown.title: Usage band: context breakdown
contextBreakdown.description: List what fills the context in the context tooltip (estimated locally)

alerts.title: Usage band: limit alerts
alerts.description: A toast when a limit crosses the yellow or red threshold

showInTerminal.title: Usage band: show in the terminal
showInTerminal.description: Off to show the band only in the desktop app

layout.title: Usage band: layout
layout.description: full: icons and bars; compact: text only

warnAt.title: Usage band: yellow from %
warnAt.description: Bars turn yellow (and a toast fires) at this percent

hotAt.title: Usage band: red from %
hotAt.description: Bars turn red (and a toast fires) at this percent

refreshSeconds.title: Usage band: refresh every (s)
refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between refreshes of limits, timers and totals (10 to 600)
